Name: (deprecated) SNES Dogs of Evermore
Author: cryomancer199x
Description:
More SNES animals for your farm.  This time we've got most of the dogs from Secret of Evermore.

This mod includes the following animals:

Gray Prehistoria Dog
White Prehistoria Dog
Brown Prehistoria Dog
Void Prehistoria Dog
Iridium Prehistoria Dog

They will all forage for bone fragments, and sometimes find one of the prehistoric bone items as a deluxe produce. Each dog can find a different one.
[b]These dogs now have their own Steel Dog barn to live in.[/b] This should, hopefully, fix the problem with them getting stuck in barn doors. Robin can built it for you, and you will need to have one to unlock buying the dogs from Marnie.

The following pets are also included:

"Spot" vanilla recolor based upon the Dog's initial appearance in Podunk at the start of the game.
The skinny Antiqua dog
The Gothica poodle dog

You can adopt them from Marnie, probably as a choice from the start too but I didn't test it. Some animations might be janky. Lemme know if anything is particularly awful. The animals tab is a little weird for the Antiqua and Gothica dogs but I don't really care to try and hunt that down tonight. Hit me up if you know what to do about it.

[b]WHERE'S BEST DOG, TOASTER DOG??

[/url]
